body_html:
Meet Jared C, also known as DJ IMP, hailing from College Park, Georgia. What drew Jared to the world of DJing was the art of seamlessly blending music and setting the perfect party atmosphere. For him, the ultimate thrill lies in entertaining people from all walks of life and creating unforgettable interactions.

Jared’s DJ sets are filled with energetic hip hop and R&B party anthems, such as Montell Jordan’s “This Is How We Do It” and Bruno Mars’ “24K Magic,” guaranteeing a packed dance floor every time. With an ambitious spirit, Jared’s passion lies in ensuring every event he DJs is a resounding success.

Outside of his DJ gigs, Jared enjoys a diverse range of hobbies, including basketball, attending church, fishing, golfing, hiking, indulging in video games, and even dabbling in gardening. But above all, he cherishes spending quality time with his three girls and beloved family.

Join DJ IMP for an unforgettable musical journey that will elevate any occasion to new heights!
